contributionSummary: Adds required expected_event_duration choices, nullable whole-minute persistence, and capped-duration review defaults with legacy fallback and regression coverage.

publicNote.description: Event organizers now choose an expected duration when creating an event, from one to three hours in half-hour steps. Arbiter preselects merit for members who attend at least half of the shorter of the event's actual and expected durations, combining attendance across its voice channels; organizers can still adjust selections before confirming, and existing events keep their previous calculation.

commits.subject: feat(event): select merit defaults using expected duration
commits.description: select merit defaults using expected duration
